follow-up time: Duration of the study is not specified.
outcome: Time to onset of sensory block
Time to two-segment regression of sensory block
Time from spinal anesthesia to complete regression of motor block
cohort: 69 pregnant women aged 20-45 years, classified as American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) grade I and II, undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: The combination of 15 mg of 0.75% isobaric ropivacaine and 0.6 mg nalbuphine provided the longest duration of effective analgesia and motor block regression time for cesarean section, with minimal side effects.
